asset_authoring.audio.title: Asset authoring: audio

task_refs.description: Create a test SoundWave, SoundClass, and SoundCue, assign class metadata, save, validate, and read references back

Create a SoundWave, bind and then remove Monolith perception user data, save it, and verify the binding is absent

Create a MetaSound Source, add a graph variable with generated get/set nodes, save it, and inspect document variables
Create a SoundWave test tone, build a one-shot MetaSound Source around it, save both assets, and read back graph and asset metadata
Create a looping ambient MetaSound Source from a SoundWave, create a preset referencing it, save all assets, and read back graph and dependency metadata
Create a synthesized MetaSound Source with oscillator and ADSR parameters, save it, and read graph summary, user parameter, and validation state back
Create two deterministic SoundWaves, build a parameter-driven interactive MetaSound crossfade graph, save all assets, and read graph and validation state back
Create a MetaSound Patch asset, add graph-level input/output pins, save it, and verify patch metadata plus user parameters
Build a MetaSound Patch from a JSON spec, add a graph node by alias, edit its editor location, remove it, save, and verify the final graph
Create a MetaSound Source, add two graph nodes by alias, discover their pins, connect and disconnect the nodes by pin name, save it, and verify the final graph
